name: FormActionBar
intent: Page-level sticky form footer — dirty-state status on the left, Discard/Save actions on the right.
when: Full-page create/edit forms that need a persistent save affordance
The form is longer than the viewport and actions must stay reachable

chooseOver.because: Dialog/Drawer/Sheet footers are modal-scoped; this one is page-scoped
Toolbar is canvas chrome (role=toolbar), not a page-pinned form footer
ContextToolbar is a compact top context bar, not a bottom action bar

ownership.expectedWrapper: Sibling of the padded content container inside an unpadded scroll region — never a child of the padded div, which would force negative margins to cancel that padding.

extracted: sticky save bar from the AdminPanel template editor surface
status slot generalised from the template's dirty-count message

lineage.confidence: unset — promoted from an in-repo template usage
notes: resolves core/Core#179: removes the hand-rolled sticky footer and its padding-coupled negative margins in frontend-2.0-admin
layers at z-30; DataTable's bulk-actions pill is z-50 and intentionally floats above it
